title: 🏆 Braun Series 9 PRO+ (boj bilan ham foydali)
caption: 🏆 Haftaning eng yaxshi chegirmasi: Braun Series 9 PRO+ Tozalash stansiyali flagman soqol olish mashinasi: $449.99 → $349.99 (−22%). 💰 Chetdan olib kelish — boj bilan ham • Tovar — $349.99 • AQShdan yetkazish — ~$14 (~1,5 kg) • Yagona bojxona to'lovi — ($349.99 − 200) × 30 % = $45 • Jami ≈ 4 818 000 so'm 🇺🇿 Toshkentda: Olcha — 7 320 000 so'm (9597cc, Yevropa versiyasi) ✅ Tejaysiz ≈ 2 502 000 so'm (34%) 💡 Farq katta bo'lsa, normadan oshgan tovar ham boj bilan birga foydali chiqadi. ⚠️ Vilka AQSh standartida (A turi) — o'tkazgich kerak. Zaryadlovchi yorlig'ida 100–240V yozilganini tekshiring. 🔗 Amazonda ko'rish 📲 Bojni ilovada hisoblang Kurs: 1 $ = 11 772,95 so'm (03.10.2026). Narxlar o'zgarishi mumkin. ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #narx
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 e-commerce discount card for a Telegram channel. Flat, modern, premium. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape covering the top ~20% of the frame.

Use the attached product photo as the hero image. Keep the product exactly as it is — do not redraw, restyle or alter it; only cut it out cleanly from its background.

LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1) Top row of pills: left — a solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text "AMAZON" (plain text, no logo); next to it — a white pill with a thin light-grey border and grey text "AQSh"; right edge — a solid crimson (#E11D48) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text "HAFTA TOP".
2) A large white rounded rectangle (24px radius) with a soft realistic drop shadow, about 40% of the frame height. The product photo centered inside it, with a soft studio shadow beneath.
3) Overlapping the top-right corner of that rectangle: a solid crimson (#E11D48) circle with a thin white outer ring. Inside, in white: large bold "-22%" and beneath it small uppercase "CHEGIRMA".
4) Headline in bold near-black (#11111B), large: "Braun Series 9 PRO+"
5) Price row: very large bold indigo (#4F46E5) "$349.99" and immediately to its right, smaller grey "$449.99" with a horizontal strikethrough line.
6) A light grey (#F6F6FB) rounded panel with a thin border containing:
   - small bold indigo uppercase label: "NARX SOLISHTIRUVI"
   - row: left grey text "O'zbekistonda (Olcha)", right bold near-black "7 320 000 so'm"
   - row: left grey text "Chetdan (tovar+yetkazish+boj)", right bold indigo "4 818 000 so'm"
   - a thin divider line
   - row: left bold green (#059669) uppercase "TEJAYSIZ", right large bold green (#059669) "2 502 000 so'm"
7) Bottom, above a thin divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo", right smaller grey "Chegirmalar - Kuryerlik - Bojxona"

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes:
AQSh modeli 9660cc, O'zbekistondagi — 9597cc (Yevropa versiyasi, xuddi shu seriya). Minimal to'lov tekshiruvi: 1,5 kg × 3 $ = 4,5 $ < 45 $.
Hisob: tovar $349.99 + yetkazish ~$14.25 + boj $45 = $409.24 × 11772.95 = 4 818 000 so'm. Tejash: 7 320 000 − 4 818 000 = 2 502 000 so'm (34%).
